raw_text: Bihar ke yuva uth khade ho! Agnipath ke khilaf aaj railway stations pe protest karo. Patna, Gaya, Muzaffarpur, Bhagalpur — sab jagah train roko. Government ko sunana hai humara gussa. Ye scheme wapas leni padegi. Rally points aur timing sab groups mein share kar do.
clean_text: Hindi-language anti-Agnipath protest call for Bihar youth to protest at railway stations. Targets Patna, Gaya, Muzaffarpur, Bhagalpur for train blockades.
